newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Aguas sinks on stake sale talk.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Aguas sinks on stake sale talk.

text.p: Shares in Spanish water treatment firm Aguas de Barcelona were sharply lower in afternoon trade amid talk that Corporacion IBV was to sell around half of its 10.3 percent stake in the firm, dealers said on Thursday.
At 1248 GMT Aguas was down 100 pesetas, 1.94 percent, to 5,050. The Ibex-35 index was down 0.13 percent to 4,506.88.

Several market sources told Reuters the placement of 2.3 million shares, lead-managed by UK brokerage BZW, was effected this morning amongst institutional clients at a price per share of around 5,000 pesetas.
The same sources said the deal would be confirmed off-market after the close this afternoon.
"What we're seeing in the market today is a reaction to the fact that IBV is set to place part of its stake to institutional clients," a trader at a Spanish brokerage said.
IBV said it would make a public statement on Friday, but would make no comment for the moment.
IBV is a joint-venture between Iberdrola and Banco Bilbao Vizcaya.
